name: Cold Follow-up
description: Polite follow-up to a previous cold email.
html_content:
Hi {first_name},

Just floating my note from last week back to the top of your inbox in case it got buried.

The short version: we help teams like yours {value_proposition}, and I'd love to learn more about what you're working on.

Would a quick call this week or next make sense? Even 10 minutes is enough to know if there's a fit.

Thanks,
{sender_name}
